description: Expected results for the official COAWST test application Inlet_test, Coupled variant (Projects/Inlet_test/Coupled, COAWST 3.8 commit 79bd6033689b): ROMS (75x70x8, 720 steps of 60 s = 12 h, sediment + morphology, analytical forcing) two-way coupled with SWAN (76x71 curvilinear grid, 36 directions) through MCT every 600 s, 1 ocean + 1 wave MPI rank. COAWST ships NO reference output for this case: all values below are OWN-RUN values (regression values), not official reference results.
engine_version: COAWST 3.8 (main, commit 79bd6033689b80b1d52f9868d52dfaf6c6e3979b; ROMS/TOMS 4.1, SWAN 41.45, MCT 2.6.0); coawstM built for INLET_TEST on 2026-10-06 (gfortran 13.3.0, Open MPI 4.1.6, netCDF-Fortran 4.5.4)

numeric_checks.why: ROMS history records: t=0 plus every NHIS=60 steps of 60 s up to NTIMES=720 (12 h)

numeric_checks.name: his_last_time_s

numeric_checks.name: coupling_exchanges
numeric_checks.why: ROMS received SWAN data 73 times: at start and every 600 s coupling interval for 12 h (log lines 'ROMS grid 1 recv data from SWAN grid 1'); proves two-way coupling ran

numeric_checks.name: swan_point1_hsig_end_m
numeric_checks.why: SWAN Hsig [m] at output point 'point1' (5000, 10000) in point1.table, last row; tol = 1e-6 relative (two runs were bit-identical)

numeric_checks.name: bath_change_absmax_m

finished_check: KI tool JSON: model returncode 0 and status success/completed_with_warnings, plus the model line 'ROMS/TOMS: DONE' in the run log
recorded_with: run 1: direct 'mpirun -np 2 coawstM Projects/Inlet_test/Coupled/coupling_inlet_test.in' in a fresh dir; run 2: KI tools/run_coawst.py (--nprocs 2) in a fresh dir. Both from /home/server/engine_builds_20261006/coawst/COAWST/coawstM (sha256 c9cfaf10ea99796573d75b1d378cadf73ca15b739ebcc5274922f290e3614e97). All 892 NetCDF variables in the 7 output .nc files and all SWAN .mat/.table/.spc2d/restart files were identical between the two runs (only SWAN's PRINT01 log differs, by its start time stamp).
notes: Inputs are the 12 tracked files of Projects/Inlet_test/Coupled plus ROMS/External/varinfo.dat, taken with git show 79bd6033689b:<path>, unmodified. The scrip_weights file named in coupling_inlet_test.in is not tracked and is not read (no MCT_INTERP_* option in inlet_test.h; ocean and wave share one grid). ocean_ini/bndry/clm/frc.nc named in ocean_inlet_test.in do not exist and are not read (analytical options); the run proves this.
run_reference.py places a byte-identical copy of coupling_inlet_test.in at the run root because the KI tool runs the model in the config file's folder (see README, Known KI gaps).
